title: I built two small tools to make my game development worklflow a little easier.
author: Sudden_Network621
selftext:
I've been working on a few game ideas lately and kept running into the same problems.

My ideas are usually pretty clear in my head, but turning them into a Game Design Document without any gaps or keeping the art style consistent across different assets is another story.

So I built two tools to help with that:

**1. GDD Forger:** Helps turn rough game ideas into structured Game Design Documents that I can actually use to create a first prototype.

**2. Artstyle Forger:** Helps define a consistent visual 2D direction for a game, so characters, environments and other assets feel like they belong together.

I recorded a quick video showing both tools in action. They're still early projects, but they've already been useful in my own workflow. 

Would love some feedback or ideas on what could make these tools more useful!
